title: add compatibility report generator and sampled performance seeder
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds an automated compatibility report generator for onboarded models and a sampled performance seeder that emits lightweight performance anchors to aid changelog and profile synthesis. Motivation: reduce manual triage when new model variants are onboarded and provide deterministic sample seeds that drive concise perf summaries for release notes. This PR bundles three small components: (1) compat report generator that introspects model metadata and runtime probes to produce a compact HTML/JSON report; (2) sample seeder that picks workload-aware probes (latency, mem, token-distribution) and stores canonical seeds for later deterministic re-runs; (3) a changelog snippet template and a CLI flag to auto-draft compatibility blurbs based on the report. Checklist: - [x] design doc (Linear ENG-3214) reviewed - [x] unit + integration tests for generator - [x] seed determinism tests - [x] CLI flag in onboardctl - [x] docs describing output and opt-out - [x] templates for changelog snippets Backwards compatibility: report generation is opt-in via onboard metadata (onboard.allow_compat_report). The seeder writes to the model's metadata bucket under a new path models/<id>/samples/v1. Rollout plan: stage flag for private deployments; default off for existing models. See docs/onboarding/compatibility-report.md for format details.

- Added an opt-in compatibility report generator for onboarded models that exports compact JSON/HTML reports.
- Added deterministic sampled performance seeder; seeds are stored under models/<id>/samples/v1 to enable reproducible lightweight perf replays.

- Changelog snippet template that can auto-draft a short compatibility blurb from the report.
